statuses.covered: a check sent or rendered it and the defence held

vectors.title: Signing domain bound to this chain and this genesis
The wallet's chain id never enters a signed typed-data domain
Wrong network: nothing is signed with the wallet on another chain
Session key: the wallet signs exactly the browser's own new key
Session key granted to a phishing clone
vectors.why: A page cannot bind its own origin into an EIP-712 signature; the wallet shows the session domain, the chain id, the genesis salt and the key, and a session key cannot move funds.

vectors.title: Withdrawal paid to an address the trader did not choose
Withdrawal to the attacker collected by a phishing clone
vectors.why: Inherent to wallet-signed withdrawals: the network cannot see the page. The app's own withdrawal screen pays only the signer's own address.

vectors.title: Typed withdrawal destination in the older transfer window
vectors.why: Not in this build: the older transfer window is loaded only when the new bridge is off.

vectors.title: App-fee approval signs exactly the link's app, fee and this account
Order with an app fee: confirm window = signed order
Batch order and cancel-all: signed = sent
TWAP place and cancel: signed = sent
Hostile app link (fee above cap, zero, self, not an address, rule off, failed reads)
App fee shown before an order is signed
Stop orders carry no app fee
Relay sign-in text rebuilt and checked by the page
Relay sign-in from a look-alike site
Clickjacking: the app framed by another site
Transport and script policy
Hidden typed-data fields
Full clone on a look-alike origin
vectors.why: A clone controls its own code, so an origin check in the page would be removed; the defences that do not depend on the page are the wallet's view of the signing domain and the network's own rules.

vectors.title: One-click trading (session key signs with no prompt)
vectors.why: One-click trading is opt-in, after a warning; orders with an app fee always open the confirm window.

vectors.title: Refund to another address: clipboard swap or typo
Referral registration collected by a phishing clone
vectors.why: A personal_sign text cannot carry the page's origin; the referral text names the chain and its genesis.

vectors.title: Community link signature without a genesis binding
vectors.why: The community link signature uses its own domain with the chain id; it links a social account and moves no money.

vectors.title: Main network relaunched at a new genesis
vectors.why: Fails closed: a chain started from a new genesis refuses signatures made under the old salt.

vectors.title: Main order paths: signed = sent = shown (plain limit, stop, close position, TP/SL)
Deposit approvals and the pinned vault
What the wallet itself shows, and the WalletConnect sources in the page policy
vectors.why: The app shows every signed value itself before the wallet is asked; WalletConnect needs its relay hosts.
